description: The House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform released 20,000 pages of documents received from the estate of Jeffrey Epstein.
headline: House Oversight Committee Releases Additional Esptein Estate Documents

info.description: One email from Jeffrey's Epstein's brother, Mark, to Jeffrey in 2018, has been a source of rampant speculation. That email reads: "Ask him [Bannon] if Putin has the photos of Trump blowing Bubba?"
info.note: The "Bubba" mentioned in the email is the main source of speculation. "Bubba" is a nickname for former president William (Bill) Clinton from his campaigning days in the early 90s. Mark has clarified that the "Bubba" in the email does not refer to Bill Clinton. Speculation occurred also that "Bubba" was the name of one of Ghislaine Maxwell's horses, but this is unconfirmed information. It is not currently known who the email might be referring to.
